messages:
elaine: Heads up — a number of users lost the 'model-admin' role after the Okta app mapping update at ~09:34 UTC. Affects JIT-provisioned accounts. :warning:

mike: @elaine can you paste a sample SAML assertion and any audit entry? I want to see if roles attribute got dropped or renamed.

elaine: Pasting redacted assertion and audit log below.

elaine: ```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="roles">
    <saml:AttributeValue>model-developer</saml:AttributeValue>
    <!-- expected model-admin missing -->
  </saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name="email">elaine@example.com</saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

elaine: audit log: `2025-06-03T09:34:12Z INFO JIT-provision user=elaine created roles=[] via okta-app:ai-platform` 

okta-bot: Configuration change detected for app 'AI Platform SAML' by kevin@redwood.com at 2025-06-03T09:30:05Z. Mapping rule 'normalize_roles' updated.

mike: Looks like normalize_roles rule trimmed values that contained '/'. We recently renamed org role from `model/admin` -> `model-admin` in Directory. The mapping regex probably only allowed exact matches and dropped unknowns.

zack: Repro steps I ran:
1) Updated Okta mapping rule on staging to use the new regex
2) Triggered SAML login
3) SAML assertion did not include roles attribute when user had legacy role `model/admin`

kevin: I pushed a change to the mapping to canonicalize slashes -> hyphens but it's a client-side mapping in Okta. My bad — I didn't add a fallback to emit legacy values.

elaine: Impact: ~12 users lost model-admin in prod, caused failed access to model infra console. No data exfil. Elevated to P2. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4821

mike: Quick mitigations:
- Roll back mapping to previous version in Okta (requires kevin)
- Update JIT handler to accept both `model/admin` and `model-admin` for 48h
- Add an audit alert if JIT creates user with empty roles

kevin: Rolling back now.

okta-bot: Rollback executed by kevin@redwood.com at 2025-06-03T09:42:10Z. Previous mapping restored.

audit-bot: Alert: 12 JIT events with empty roles between 2025-06-03T09:31:00Z - 09:36:00Z. See SEC-4821.

zack: After rollback I can confirm new log shows roles restored in assertion. Example:

zack: ```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="roles">
    <saml:AttributeValue>model-admin</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

elaine: Plan: kevin to add mapping that emits both normalized and raw values, mike to ship JIT code change to treat empty roles as preserve previous role or fallback to attribute `groups`, and then schedule a post-mortem. Can we get a quick canary for the JIT change?

mike: I'll cut a canary branch, deploy to dedicated-canary and monitor audit logs for 30m. If no empty-role creations, we'll roll to prod.

kevin: I'll create Okta test mapping that explicitly outputs `roles: model-admin,model/deprecated` and add unit tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/okta-mappings/pull/67

elaine: Thanks. Add a note to the postmortem about missing test coverage for rename scenarios and require an explicit mapping policy for role renames. I'll draft postmortem and include timeline and rollback decision.

zack: Adding monitoring: create metric `jit.created_empty_roles` and alert if > 1 in 10m. I'll configure now.

mike: Noted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
